Common questions
DOT physical & employer FAQs

        

          
Where can I get a DOT physical near Dubuque?
At Burds Family Practice in Peosta, just west of Dubuque on U.S. 20. Owner Jenny Burds, DNP, ARNP is a certified medical examiner on the FMCSA National Registry, so your DOT/CDL medical card is valid nationwide. Call (563) 588-6659 to schedule.

          
What should I bring to my DOT physical?
Bring your driver's license, your glasses, contacts or hearing aids, and a list of your medications with doses. If you're treated for a condition such as sleep apnea, diabetes or heart disease, bring recent records from that provider (for example, CPAP compliance reports) so we can complete your exam in one visit.

          
Do you do pre-employment physicals and drug screens?
Yes. We offer pre-employment physicals, 12-panel drug screening, audiograms and return-to-work clearances, with same-week scheduling for local employers.

          
Can my company set up an account?
Yes. Employers across western Dubuque County work with us directly, with one point of contact for scheduling and results. Call the clinic to get started.

          
Do you treat work injuries?
We provide work injury evaluation and follow-up care, and coordinate return-to-work clearances. For severe injuries or emergencies, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room.
